overall_notes: This paper focuses on evaluating Quality Estimation systems for Machine Translation, with both automatic metrics (F1, MCC, TER) and human evaluation. The NLG outputs include quality estimation tags and post-edited translations. Human evaluation was comprehensive with subjective ratings, timing metrics, and translation quality assessment.
